propositions: Ordinal severity labels (low/medium/high) on undecomposed and dod_uncertifiable axes do not reliably separate blocking from advisory outcomes and must be replaced with closed semantic kind sets.

The undecomposed axis must be replaced with three kinds: none, bundles_separable_slices (advisory, contributes 0.55), and two gap kinds (missing_required_child, no_executable_breakdown) that floor at 0.85.

The dod_uncertifiable axis must be replaced with three kinds: none, underspecified_certification (advisory, contributes 0.55), and two gap kinds (uncertifiable_outcome, certification_cannot_prove) that floor at 0.85.
The inert G5-suppressor hedge (veto_undecomposed_g5) fires zero times and must be removed from both prompts, descriptions, and all code paths.

A re-score script must validate the conversion against 22,667 historical findings by mapping recorded grades to kinds via ordered regex over prose+evidence, reporting both optimistic (floor=0.85) and pessimistic (advisory=0.55) bounds and confirming no unjustified lost blocks.
IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION must be bumped plan-v4 -> plan-v5 in sidecar.py and per-finding priority-minus-block_threshold margin telemetry must be persisted.
